new-games-a.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an eight-pose transparent game sprite sheet using the attached canonical character reference as exact identity. Snowstar is a childlike girl with an enormous sculptural rainbow-colored hairstyle of curled loops and pointed pastel panels, very large blue-green eyes with tiny daisy highlights, a small smiling face, a ribbed moss-green turtleneck sweater, teal-blue pants and lime-green cuffed boots. Keep the signature flower bow at the top of her hair and side flower ornaments. Preserve her exact face, hair, outfit, colors, proportions, accessory details and existing polished navy-outlined cel-shaded storybook look in every pose. Exactly EIGHT separate complete full-body figures in a 4-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then next row, one centered figure per equal cell, consistent head size and proportions, three-quarter view facing right, generous transparent gutters, no clipping of hair, hands or feet. Row 1: (1) tug-of-war ready: feet planted, torso leaning back left, both empty hands held together reaching forward-right at waist height to grip an invisible rope, determined happy grin; (2) tug heave: leaning farther back left, knees bent, same forward empty grip, cheerful exertion; (3) fishing reel ready: leaning back slightly, forward hand gripping an invisible rod just above chest height, other hand beside it preparing to crank, happy focused gaze right; (4) fishing reel crank: same stance and forward grip, other hand moved inward and down to crank an invisible reel, bright grin. Row 2: (5) overhead bat-swing windup: both empty hands together above right shoulder/overhead, legs braced, gleeful face; (6) bat-swing follow-through: both empty hands moved forward-right and upward above face, finishing a gentle overhead strike, cheerful grin; (7) putting ready: side-on facing right, knees softly bent, looking down-right, both empty hands together low in front/right at thigh height holding an invisible putter; (8) putting follow-through: same stance, low empty hands swung slightly forward-right, looking up-right hopefully. Empty grips only. No rope, rod, fishing line, bat, putter, ball, scenery, shadows, ground, effects, words, labels, panels, borders or background. Transparent background.
new-games-a.editNote: Built-in imagegen edit removed the baked green rod from A row 1 column 3; held/cranking hands remain empty.

new-games-b.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a four-pose transparent game sprite sheet using the attached canonical character reference as exact identity. Snowstar is a childlike girl with an enormous sculptural rainbow-colored hairstyle of curled loops and pointed pastel panels, very large blue-green eyes with tiny daisy highlights, a small smiling face, a ribbed moss-green turtleneck sweater, teal-blue pants and lime-green cuffed boots. Keep her signature flower bow at the top of her hair and side flower ornaments. Preserve exact face, hair, outfit, colors, proportions and polished navy-outlined cel-shaded finish in every pose. Exactly FOUR separate complete full-body figures in ONE horizontal row, read left-to-right, one centered figure per equal cell, consistent head size/proportions, three-quarter view facing right, generous transparent gutters, no clipping of hair, hands or feet. (1) spring-jump: launching joyfully upward, both arms straight up, knees tucked, feet lifted, delighted grin and upward gaze; (2) snow-scoop: deeply crouched close to ground, both empty hands together low in front/right, curved palms packing an invisible snowball, focused cheerful face, feet planted; (3) dig: low crouch, legs spread slightly, torso leaning forward/right, both hands scooping down between legs then back toward left, gleeful focused face, feet planted; (4) skip-hop: light two-footed jump-rope hop, knees tucked slightly, both arms extended out to sides around waist/chest height, joyful face, feet lifted. Full figure fits. No snowball, tools, rope, clouds, scenery, shadows, effects, words, labels, panels, borders or background. Transparent background.
